summary: Our project, Space Mission Design Game, is an interactive educational game that allows users to design and manage their own space missions. Players can select spacecraft, scientific instruments, launch vehicles and communication systems while working within a limited budget, mass and power capacity. The game simulates the different stages of a space mission, from planning and spacecraft design to launch and mission operation. Players must make important engineering decisions and understand how each decision affects mission performance and success. This project aims to make space science and engineering more interesting and accessible to students through interactive learning, creativity and problem-solving.
details: Our project, Space Mission Design Game, is an interactive educational simulation that allows users to create, plan and manage their own space missions. The game starts by allowing players to select a mission objective, such as exploring Mars, studying the Moon or investigating an asteroid. Players can then select spacecraft, launch vehicles, scientific instruments and communication systems. Each selection affects important mission parameters such as cost, mass, power consumption and mission performance. Players must manage limited resources and make engineering decisions to complete their missions successfully. The main objective is to help students understand the challenges involved in real space mission planning. The game combines space science, engineering concepts, logical thinking and decision-making in an enjoyable learning environment. The project is designed using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. It focuses on interactive learning, creativity and making complex space engineering concepts easier to understand.
